transcript: This is the number one thing you can do for your digestion and almost nobody does it. After you finish eating, don't sit down, don't lie down and definitely don't start scrolling on your phone. Instead, take a 10-minute walk. That simple habit can reduce bloating, improve digestion, decrease acid reflux, and help food move through your digestive system more efficiently. The moment you start walking, you stimulate your digestive tract and help your intestines do what they're supposed to do. Less bloating, less discomfort, better digestion. And if you struggle with constipation, walking after meals can help stimulate regular bowel movements naturally. Your gut was designed to move, so after your next meal, don't sit, walk. And if you really want to support your digestion, make sure you're getting enough fiber every day. Most people aren't even close. That's why I recommend adding a quality fiber supplement alongside habits like walking after meals. The fiber I personally recommend is in the link on my profile or in the comments down below.
